item.title: Allegations of human composting made against San Joaquin River Parkway Trust
item.description: Disturbing allegations were made Thursday afternoon against the San Joaquin River Parkway Trust about a section of land along the river off Friant Road in Fresno County.

item.title: Casting nominee reacts to Oscars' first new category in 25 years
item.description: This new category is one that's behind-the-scenes, but without it, there could be no movie magic. Once there's a script, there needs to be actors to play the roles. That's where casting directors come in.

item.title: California official calling on Trump admin. to return deaf boy, his family deported to Colombia
item.description: California State Superintendent Tony Thurmond is demanding the immediate return of a deaf student and his family who were deported to Colombia this week.

item.title: Registered sex offender Rene Campos fails to get signatures needed for Fresno City Council candidacy
item.description: Registered sex offender Rene Campos failed to reach the required number of signatures to be included on the ballot for the Fresno City Council District 7 race.
